character: The 'Green Hell' — a 20.8km, 73-corner ribbon through the Eifel forest with extreme elevation changes and blind crests. Demands memorisation and bravery; mistakes are severely punished by close barriers.
sources: https://www.nuerburgring.de/en/ ; long-established Nordschleife corner naming (Hatzenbach, Flugplatz, Adenauer Forst, Fuchsröhre, Bergwerk, Karussell, Pflanzgarten, Döttinger Höhe)

corners.name: Hatzenbach
corners.technique: Commit through the blind, undulating corners with smooth steering
corners.trap: Lifting unnecessarily on the blind crests loses significant time

corners.name: Flugplatz
corners.type: fast crest where the car goes light
corners.technique: Stay smooth as the car unloads over the crest, minimal steering correction
corners.trap: Aggressive inputs while the car is light causes a snap

corners.name: Adenauer Forst
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed into the tightening second part

corners.name: Fuchsröhre
corners.technique: Commit through the compression at high speed, trust the car
corners.trap: Braking or lifting in the dip unsettles the car badly

corners.name: Bergwerk
corners.type: slow, tight right-hander after a fast section
corners.technique: Hard braking from very high speed, patient entry
corners.trap: Misjudging the braking point after the fast approach — a notorious accident site

corners.name: Karussell
corners.technique: Use the banked concrete gutter to carry speed through the corner
corners.trap: Missing the banking and taking the corner conventionally loses significant time

corners.name: Pflanzgarten
corners.technique: Commit through the compressions and crests with smooth inputs
corners.trap: The car can become airborne here — excess speed or poor line risks a big moment

corners.name: Döttinger Höhe
corners.type: long flat-out straight before the final corners
corners.technique: Full commitment, prepare early for the braking zone at the end
corners.trap: Not preparing early enough for the heavy braking after the flat-out section
